description: Retry only an existing record's failed expertise domains, then update its output and attempt the run's fusion/synchronization. Billed for retried work. Requires failed_expertises on that record (get_record); a surviving successful sibling is not retryable and returns no_failed_expertises. Supply its entity_input_data and saved_schema_id; model optionally substitutes the failed model. Returns job_id: poll get_job_status, then re-read get_record. When the failed leg left no record, use a one-model enrich_entity with database_sync=false followed by merge_records instead. Recovery decisions: enricher://docs/enrichment-and-fusion.

enable_web_search.description: On your model (the default), true asks you to ground the answers with your own web search tool and false not to; omitted returns web_search_undecided so you ask the user first. On platform models, true enables the provider's builtin search where the model supports it (omitted = false).
enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search

entity_data.description: The record's original entity input (get_record -> entity_input_data).
entity_data.title: Entity Data

model.description: Model to retry with. Omitted (the default), the retry runs on YOUR model or, with use_platform_models=true, on the record's own model. Name a stronger provider::model (list_models) only when a domain fails repeatedly on the record's model and the user agrees; that runs the retry on the platform (billed). Only the failed domains are re-run and re-billed; the record stays attributed to its original model.
model.title: Model

reasoning_effort.description: Thinking (reasoning) opt-in: low, medium or high; omitted = off. On the platform, auto then picks only a model whose reasoning the platform can pilot, and the effort is translated per provider. On YOUR model, apply the effort yourself when you run the requests.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

schema_id.description: Saved schema UUID (get_record -> saved_schema_id). Or pass target_schema.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

target_schema.description: Raw schema dict when no saved schema exists.
target_schema.title: Target Schema

use_platform_models.description: false (default): every LLM call of this job runs on YOUR model — the job parks each call as a pending request you answer with answer_llm_request; no credits are consumed. true: the job runs on the platform (billed) and, with the model left on auto, on the organization's best model for the task — its highest blended benchmark score under the organization's quality/speed/cost weights, among the models that satisfy the run (attachments, web search, thinking). Naming a platform model also runs the job there, bypassing that pick: do it only when the user named one. Protocol: enricher://docs/llm-delegation.
use_platform_models.title: Use Platform Models

name: retry_expertises
title: Retry failed expertises
